description:
Add telemetry events that bookend the extension loading lifecycle. Tests synchronize via :telemetry instead of Process.sleep. Per-extension :loaded and :load_error events already exist (telemetry_handler.ex:6-12) — this ticket adds the lifecycle bookends.

## Deliverable

[:octo_pi_coder, :extensions, :load_started] emitted when handle_continue begins. [:octo_pi_coder, :extensions, :load_complete] emitted with count measurement and extension_ids metadata at the end. TelemetryHandler logs both. --debug-telemetry captures both to debug_telemetry.log.

## Steps

STEP 1 — Verify both telemetry events are emitted from Session.handle_continue (covered structurally by opi-fin.13; this ticket verifies the pipeline end-to-end).

STEP 2 — Update OctoPi.Coder.Extension.TelemetryHandler @events list (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/telemetry_handler.ex:6-12) to include both new events.

STEP 3 — Add handle_event/4 clauses for the two new event names. Add handle_file_event/4 clauses (the --debug-telemetry path).

STEP 4 — Document the pattern in a test helper module so any extension test can: subscribe → start session → assert_receive within 1s.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] OctoPi.Coder.Extension.TelemetryHandler.@events module attribute includes both [:octo_pi_coder, :extensions, :load_started] and [:octo_pi_coder, :extensions, :load_complete]
- [ ] handle_event/4 clauses exist for both events (verify via grep)
- [ ] handle_file_event/4 clauses exist for both events (--debug-telemetry path)
- [ ] Test: attach to :load_complete, start Session, assert_receive {:loaded, %{count: N}, %{extension_ids: ids}} within 1s. NO Process.sleep.
- [ ] When `mix pi --debug-telemetry` runs, debug_telemetry.log contains a [load_started] line and a [load_complete] line with the expected count and extension_ids
- [ ] No test in the suite uses Process.sleep to wait for extension loading

## Dependencies
